annotations.title: Save a preview as a draft

description: Save an unexpired anonymous preview into the authenticated organization as a draft. Requires an org API key or OAuth sign-in with the forms:write scope. Same save as POST /api/v1/tools/previews/{id}/claim. previewId is the token in previewUrl (/tools/p/{previewId}). Returns formId and editorUrl (/app/forms/{formId}). An unknown or expired preview is an error. A preview already saved by another organization is refused. Claiming the same preview again for this organization returns the same draft.
name: claim_preview

formId.description: Draft form id saved from the preview.

grader.description: Grade of the saved draft, when one was stored.
